{{see also|Cookbook:Mejadra}}

'''Mjeddrah''' is a stout lentil and rice stew, a Lebanese staple. 

==Ingredients==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] brown [[Cookbook:Lentil|lentils]], soaked an hour or more
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], sliced
* A little chopped [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]], [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]], etc. (optional)
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* ½ cup long grain [[Cookbook:Rice|brown rice]], rinsed
* 3 cups water
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] whole or ground [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]
* [[Cookbook:Mincing|Minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] (optional)
* Dried [[Cookbook:Chiles|chile pepper]] (optional)
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]] stick (optional)
* A few [[Cookbook:Cardamom|cardamom]] pods (optional)
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste

==Procedure==
# Pick over the lentils to remove any stones. 
# [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] the onion and any other vegetables in the olive oil for a minute or two. 
# If desired, sauté the rice for a short time, but do not let it burn.
# Add the rice, water, cumin, garlic, chili pepper, cinnamon, and cardamom to the pot of onions. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], cover, and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 40 minutes to 1 hour. You will have to check it occasionally and add water—the final product should have some liquid but should not be very soupy. It is finished when the rice and lentils are both no longer crunchy.
# Season with salt and pepper.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* A little [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]] is tasty sprinkled on as a garnish.
* Sauté some chopped onion and garlic quickly in oil until it browns (a slight burning is good), then stir it into some natural [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yogurt]] and use as a garnish.
